answer: Concrete sybil resistance via raven patrols: each epoch 7 auditors are drawn at random from the staked pool and each identity must survive an unannounced raven inspection of its work logs. Entry needs a meadow bond of 12,000 POA locked for 20 epochs plus 6 independent vouchers who each stake 500 POA. Reputation is an onyx token bound to the identity and burned on transfer. An attacker running N sybils must post 12,000N POA for 20 epochs, recruit 6N distinct vouchers risking 500 POA each, and pass 7 inspections per epoch, so per-head cost never amortizes and detection rises with N.
